title: Diagnose sflag Hang
description: Perform chronological ascending (--order=ASC) analysis of TensorCore/SparseCore sflag timeouts, SparseCore tag:pc sequencer halts, DCN action stalls, minority outlier grouping (< 20%), silent/missing pod detection across slice topologies, and concurrent telemetry host mapping using diagnose_sflag_hang.py.

workload_prefix.description: Workload name or pod prefix (e.g. my-tpu-workload).

freshness.description: gcloud log-read window (defaults to 180d to avoid missing incidents older than 1 day).

expected_pods.description: Optional expected worker pods per slice (0 auto-infers from observed <slice>-<worker> pod indices) for silent pod detection.

max_concurrent_workers.description: Maximum concurrent threads for parallel telemetry node-to-host resolution.

output_file.description: Path to write the structured JSON diagnosis report.
